displayIdentity.body: The scene includes shared flesh and blood, death, and the devil. It also includes slavery through fear, Abraham’s offspring, and merciful priesthood. It also includes atonement, suffering, and temptation. It also includes help. Together, these details are linked in the passage.
displayIdentity.title: Through death Jesus brings the devil’s power of death to nothing
